summary: Full backend + frontend regression for Astro Shraddha. 9/9 backend pytest tests pass. End-to-end UI flows (navigation, booking with manual fallback, contact submission, about content, footer/contact email + WhatsApp link) all verified.

issues: Video thumbnail images are generic Unsplash portraits (not real customers). Acceptable for MVP but may want branded placeholders later.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py has a DUPLICATE logging.basicConfig() and logger reassignment at lines 436-440 (already correctly initialized at the top). Harmless but should be removed for cleanliness.
/app/backend/server.py: razorpay client is created at import time only if keys exist. Good — manual fallback path is clean.
/app/backend/server.py: list_bookings has no auth — anyone hitting GET /api/bookings can view all bookings (PII: name/email/phone/DOB). Consider an admin token before going live.
seed_data_creation: Test data was inserted with TEST_ prefix into MongoDB collections 'bookings' and 'contact_messages' via the public APIs as part of the test run. These remain in the DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_astro_api.py covers all current endpoints. To re-run: `cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/test_astro_api.py -v`. Razorpay keys are intentionally empty in /app/backend/.env so the booking flow exercises the manual fallback (is_live=false then POST /api/bookings/{id}/mark-manual). Frontend public URL: https://stellar-astrology-1.preview.emergentagent.com. All UI elements have data-testid (service-card-*, booking-submit-button, contact-submit-button, nav-link-*, date-picker-trigger, time-select, etc.).
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. The previous testing agent's report of an uninitialized logger bug has been confirmed fixed (logger is now defined right after load_dotenv on line 25).
